user_report.observed_behavior: Equipment list filtering and equipment selection are unusable, and model choices are not ordered from the cheapest model to the most expensive model.

reproduction.root_cause: The dynamic equipment facet required every candidate configuration to have a complete non-unknown statement for an attribute. After the portfolio expanded to 72 configurations, no equipment attribute satisfied that global completeness condition, so all 110 equipment buttons were hidden.

fix_contract.equipment_visibility_rule: Show an equipment attribute when it is source-confirmed as standard or optional in at least one currently compatible configuration and at least one other configuration is confirmed unavailable, unknown or missing the statement.
fix_contract.matching_rule: A selected equipment requirement is satisfied only by a source-confirmed standard or optional state. Missing, unknown and not-available states remain exclusions and are never inferred as available.
fix_contract.selection_conflict_rule: Keep conflicting selected equipment visible and selected; do not silently remove user choices when no configuration satisfies all selected requirements.

model_order_contract.rule: Order model choices by the minimum recorded current Polish catalogue gross price among active configurations, then by model name and model code.
model_order_contract.missing_price_rule: Models without any recorded current catalogue price sort after all models with a recorded minimum price.

immutability.delivery: Publish the correction as a new patch release after the source fix is merged and independently verified.

next_package.name: Data Products v1.8.1 Release Preparation
next_package.goal: Prepare and verify a patch release containing the restored equipment filtering and cheapest-to-most-expensive model ordering, without changing source-backed data or rewriting older public releases.
